descs.en: The actress who spent three years bowing to his family. The lawyer who stayed silent until the day she left.

ideaNote: Planned: 50 chapters. The Match · The Silence · The Ocean · The Premiere · Side stories.

synopsis.title: Synopsis
synopsis.content:
Yen Si-Yuan is the most famous of the Yen triplets, an actress on billboards across Asia. Yang Pengcheng is the lawyer sent to clean up a legal mess on her film set, and the only man in the room who isn’t starstruck. She decides he’s a challenge. He decides she’s a logical match.

For three years she bows at his family’s dinners while they ignore her, and he says nothing. Then, at a gala, his mother insults her in front of everyone, and he says nothing again. She moves her filming overseas and puts an ocean between them, and for the first time in his life, Yang Pengcheng finds out what silence costs.

authorNote.title: Author Note
authorNote.content:
This is the book in the series with real angst: a marriage that hurts, and a man who has to learn that staying silent is a choice and not a neutral one.

The repair is slow and it’s earned. The early love scenes are distant and dutiful; the later ones are him learning to look at her, to speak, to stay. You’ll see the turn in how he touches her. He falls asleep on her shoulder during script reads.

Planned content includes:

• Emotional neglect within a relationship

• Public humiliation by a partner’s family

• Separation and a long period of no contact

• Online abuse and tabloid cruelty aimed at an actress
